age.evidence: The animals were 9-10 weeks of age on arrival and habituated to human contact until the start of experiments 2-3 weeks later.

sex.evidence: A total of 415 male Sprague Dawley rats ... were used in the fear conditioning experiments and 60 male Wistar Hannover rats ... were used in the elevated plus maze (EPM) study.

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (2 mg/kg) reduced freezing (U = 21.0, P < .01). All injections were given subcutaneously.
Both 5-HT2A receptor agonists 25CN-NBOH (3 mg/kg) (U = 13.0, P < .01) ... reduced freezing. All injections were given subcutaneously.
TCB-2 (1 mg/kg) (U = 21.0, P < .05) reduced freezing. All injections were given subcutaneously.

handling.evidence: habituated to human contact until the start of experiments 2-3 weeks later

group_housing.evidence: They were housed 3 per cage in an animal facility

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12-hour-light/-dark cycle (direction not specified)

enrichment_housing.evidence: Home-cage enrichment not addressed in the paper.

assays.assay_description: Rats received 5 foot shocks (0.6 mA, 30-s ISI) in a Med Associates conditioning chamber after a 5-min acclimatization. Seven days later, rats were re-exposed to the chamber for 5 minutes; freezing (immobility >1 s) was automatically scored from video and expressed as % time immobile. Psychedelic agonists (psilocybin 2 mg/kg, 25CN-NBOH 3 mg/kg, TCB-2 1 mg/kg) were given s.c. 30 min before test, with or without MDL 100907 / SB 242084 pretreatment.

application_type.evidence: All injections were given subcutaneously with an injection volume of approximately 1 mL.

setup_habituation.evidence: After an acclimatization period of 5 minutes [on the conditioning day], received 5 electric foot shocks; no separate pre-test apparatus habituation described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were re-exposed to the conditioning chamber for assessment of context-conditioned freezing (freely moving).

food_restriction.evidence: Standard fear conditioning chamber with grid floor; no food in the apparatus during the 5-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard fear conditioning chamber; no water in the apparatus during the 5-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: Drug injections were administered 50, 40, and/or 30 minutes prior to test.

sample_size.evidence: Number of animals per group = 7-9 (Experiment VII); other experiments n = 10-12 per group.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (2 mg/kg), 25CN-NBOH (3 mg/kg), and TCB-2 (1 mg/kg) each significantly reduced context-conditioned freezing relative to saline. The effects of psilocybin and 25CN-NBOH were blocked by the 5-HT2A inverse agonist MDL 100907 (1 mg/kg), whereas TCB-2's effect was not blocked by MDL 100907 or SB 242084.
outcomes.statistics: Psilocybin vs saline: U = 21.0, P < .01; Psilocybin+MDL vs psilocybin: U = 23.0, P < .01. 25CN-NBOH vs saline: U = 13.0, P < .01; 25CN-NBOH+MDL vs 25CN-NBOH: U = 6.0, P < .001. TCB-2 vs saline: U = 21.0, P < .05; TCB-2+MDL vs TCB-2: U = 42.0, P = .55.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin (2 mg/kg) reduced freezing (U = 21.0, P < .01). Both 5-HT2A receptor agonists 25CN-NBOH (3 mg/kg) (U = 13.0, P < .01) and TCB-2 (1 mg/kg) (U = 21.0, P < .05) reduced freezing.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Freezing presented as the percentage (%) of the 5-minute test that the animal spent immobile.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data reported as total % freezing over the 5-min test; no within-session time course.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions or behavioural sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Conditioned freezing is not an ethological behaviour per the rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Animals tested individually in the conditioning chamber.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Task requires recall of a previously learned context-shock association acquired 7 days earlier.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Med Associates Contextual NIR Video Fear Conditioning System using automatic immobility threshold scoring — position/motion-based, not a behavioural classifier.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Analyses limited to Kruskal-Wallis and Mann-Whitney U tests on a single measure.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Contextual NIR Video Fear Conditioning System for Rat (Med Associates).

E2_shelter.evidence: Conditioning chamber with grid floor; no shelter present.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the test chamber.

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats were re-exposed individually to the conditioning chamber.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the chamber during the 5-min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each rat had one 5-min test session 7 days after conditioning; freezing data are reported only for the test session.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Percentage (%) of the 5-minute test that the animal spent immobile.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Behavioural freezing data are reported only from the single re-exposure test day; conditioning-day behaviour was not reported as outcome.

D5_followup.evidence: Test conducted 30 min after drug administration; no ≥24 h post-dose follow-up.

assays.assay_description: Wistar Hannover rats placed on a standard black acrylic EPM (Med Associates) under 35 lux for 5 minutes; number of entries and time on open arms scored from video. Animals received escitalopram (5 mg/kg s.c.) with or without MDL 100907 (3 mg/kg s.c.) 30-40 min before test. No 5-HT2A agonist psychedelic was administered in this assay (only the inverse agonist MDL 100907 + SSRI), so it does not qualify as a psychedelic-administration assay per the rubric.

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals moved to the room for acclimatization 90 minutes prior to testing (room acclimation only, not apparatus habituation).

food_restriction.evidence: Standard EPM; no food in the apparatus during testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard EPM; no water in the apparatus during testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: Drug or saline injections were administered 40 and/or 30 minutes prior to test.

sample_size.evidence: 60 male Wistar Hannover rats ... Number of animals per group = 15.

outcomes.summary: Escitalopram (5 mg/kg) did not affect time on open arms but reduced open-arm entries; the 5-HT2A inverse agonist MDL 100907 (3 mg/kg) had no effect alone and did not modify the escitalopram response. No psychedelic 5-HT2A agonist was tested in the EPM.
outcomes.statistics: Escitalopram vs saline (open-arm entries): U = 66.0, P < .05.
outcomes.evidence: The SSRI escitalopram (5 mg/kg) did not impact the time spent on open arms but reduced the number of entries onto open arms (U = 66.0, P < .05). The inverse 5-HT2A receptor agonist MDL 100907 (3 mg/kg) displayed no effect per se and did not impact the response to escitalopram.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Number of entries onto open arms, and the total time spent on open arms.

B4_ethological.evidence: Time/entries on open arms are spatial avoidance measures, not ethological acts.

B6_cognitive.evidence: EPM tests innate avoidance, not learned behaviour.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Captured using video recordings and manually analyzed after the experiment.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Standard black acrylic plastic rat EPM (Med Associates).

E2_shelter.evidence: Closed arms of EPM are not scored as shelter per rubric.

E6_spatial.evidence: Per rubric, EPM arms do not count as multiple zones.

D2_session_duration.evidence: The rats spent 5 minutes in the maze.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline EPM measure reported.

judge_notes: Merged all eight fear-conditioning experiments (I-IV, VI-VIII) into a single contextual fear conditioning assay per rubric (same paradigm, different drug arms = 1 assay).

Included EPM as a separate assay for completeness because the study administered drugs including 5-HT2A ligands; however no 5-HT2A AGONIST psychedelic was tested in the EPM — only the SSRI escitalopram with/without MDL 100907 inverse agonist. Some reviewers may exclude this assay since no psychedelic agonist was administered.
B7 (automated classification) overridden to 0: candidate gptoss scored 1, but Med Associates automatic immobility scoring is a motion-threshold system, which the rubric explicitly lists as score 0.
n_male in sex block set to 475 (415 SD + 60 WH) to match total subjects across the study.
day_night_flipped set to 'not_reported' because the paper states a 12:12 cycle without specifying direction; per rubric, direction-silent statements are 'not_reported'.
